snippet.title: Mind Control: Bloody Renaissance gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Mind Control: Bloody Renaissance is a story-driven Survivor Horror RPG with a rail shooting gallery-like combat system and an intricate plot with light detective elements.

Add the game to your Steam wishlist.
